title: Mason Rudolph is happy Myles Garrett has left the AFC North

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mason Rudolph is happy Myles Garrett has left the AFC North
sources.description: Defensive end Myles Garrett and quarterback Mason Rudolph became forever linked in NFL lore on the night of November 14, 2019, when Garrett ripped away Rudolph's helmet and struck him over the head with it.
